caption: The drawing depicts a decorative ceramic vessel with an ornate, curvilinear shape, set against a plain beige background. The main vessel is centrally placed and is rendered in soft hues of greens, blues, and creams, with some yellow and purple highlights along the contours, giving it an iridescent appearance. The rim of the vessel has a wavy, uneven edge accented with a thin gold outline, and the body features swirling raised patterns on its surface. On the vessel's right side is a protruding handle with a similarly ornate design. Below the central object, a smaller inset drawing shows a top-down view of the vessel, displaying its circular opening and curving structure, with similar color detailing. At the top of the page, inside a rectangular box, there is hand-written text in green ink: "H. Tatler / C.O. Decorating Co." The objects are enclosed within lightly sketched rectangular borders.
title: Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
